rules.statement: A contract may be avoided by Court on the ground of laesio enormis either when the purchaser pays more than double the true value of the thing or the vendor sells the thing for less than half its value.
rules.supporting_quote: This inequality between the value of the thing and the price paid is termed laesio enormis. A contract may be avoided by Court on the ground of laesio enormis either when the purchaser pays more than double the true value of the thing or the vendor sells the thing for less than half its value.
